kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تكأكأت (form IIq)
# تَكَأْكَأْتُ (takaʔkaʔtu) /ta.kaʔ.kaʔ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَكَأْكَأَ (takaʔkaʔa)
# تَكَأْكَأْتَ (takaʔkaʔta) /ta.kaʔ.kaʔ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَكَأْكَأَ (takaʔkaʔa)
# تَكَأْكَأْتِ (takaʔkaʔti) /ta.kaʔ.kaʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَكَأْكَأَ (takaʔkaʔa)
# تَكَأْكَأَتْ (takaʔkaʔat) /ta.kaʔ.ka.ʔat/: t
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
